digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool management and convergence boundary
propositions: tool_step_limit filtering by rewriting toolsets to empty `tools`/`toolConfig` violates Bedrock/Anthropic provider protocol when `toolUse` history is present, raising ValidationException 400
every armed site experiences provider 400 errors when runs exceed `tool_step_limit`, especially bounded-recovery fallback with evidence tool steps
steering mechanism must advertise tool definitions for the entire run while returning synthetic results past the limit to keep requests protocol-valid
steering is advisory and does not weaken the terminal budget enforced by `UsageLimits(request_limit, tool_calls_limit)`, so non-cooperative models still exhaust and raise `UsageLimitExceeded`
unit tests must be rewritten to validate steering semantics rather than filtered toolsets, and live Bedrock experiments prove the new mechanism works end-to-end
